cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not About Who Lost
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on rules, effort, or next steps instead of the result that embarrasses you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll review my race pacing before you read out the results. Bring me the halfway split; I'll start there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stopped halfway. That's why there's no second split.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you may mark the first half as our review point. Tell me what pace I held before the stop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everybody else finished. Their times are on the board beside you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave their finish times for later. Bring their halfway splits beside mine, and we'll compare the part I completed. I'll decide the next training session from that; we're discussing pace first.

reason: Make A use the absence of a second split and B comparison board to control a selective training review, concretely redirecting result embarrassment into effort and next steps.
